summary: @indievc Must be nice to be given the funds to build an arc before you even know which sea you will set adrift in. Glad to see it work out and the choice was made to back out. Going cold turkey ain't easy.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @indievc Must be nice to be given the funds to build an arc before you even know which sea you will set adrift in. Glad to see it work out and the choice was made to back out. Going cold turkey ain't easy.
